profile.tagline: Test Automation Engineer, career changer from teaching

summary.summary: Eleven years as a teacher for mathematics and computer science, since 2025 in test automation. Writes Playwright tests in TypeScript and explains technical topics clearly.

list.details:
- End-to-end tests with Playwright and TypeScript for the web shop of a sports retailer, about 150 tests
- API tests with the Playwright request context for the order and basket services
- Pipelines in GitHub Actions, first pipeline in Azure DevOps for a second team
- Uses an AI assistant to draft test code, reviews every result before commit
- Explains test results to product owners in plain language

- Six-month retraining: JavaScript and TypeScript, Playwright, Git, REST basics
- ISTQB Foundation preparation
- Final project: test suite for a demo shop

list.position: Teacher for Mathematics and Computer Science
list.details:
- Taught mathematics and computer science in grades 7 to 13, class teacher for six years
- Introduced digital tools to the department and trained colleagues
- Led the working group for the new computer science curriculum
- Regular talks with parents, students and school management

list.title: Public Playwright demo suite
list.tagline: An open demo suite for a public sample shop with page objects, API checks and a pipeline run on every push.
